blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Puerto Princesa City, Palawan, is expected to experience a heat index of 45°C on Monday, Nov. 16, placing it under the danger category, the state weather bureau said Sunday. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) also forecast heat indices of 43°C in Coron in Palawan, and Zamboanga City. Pagasa classifies heat indices ranging from 42°C to 51°C as dangerous, warning that prolonged exposure to these conditions may cause heat cramps, heat exhaustion and heat stroke.
